summary: Iteration 4 verifies TeraPlayer mobile responsiveness across 3 viewports (iPhone SE 375x667, iPhone 12 390x844, Android 360x640). ALL 14 assertions from the review request PASS. No horizontal scroll on any viewport, all mobile header icons visible & tap-target compliant, hero title fits (~30px, within 28-40px range), Preview submit button is 40x40 with arrow-only SVG (no 'Preview' text), PASTE clipboard button is display:none < sm, features strip renders as clean 2x2 grid on all mobile widths, invalid-URL flow renders error-panel without introducing overflow, history drawer opens full-width up to max-w-md and is dismissible via Escape, and theme toggle (dark -> light) removes the 'dark' class from <html> while preserving zero horizontal scroll. Tap-target audit found ZERO buttons under 32px at 375px width.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroInput.jsx: correctly hides 'Preview' text label via `hidden sm:inline` and shows the arrow icon in all breakpoints - verified svg count == 1 on all 3 mobile viewports.
HeroInput.jsx: paste-clipboard-btn correctly uses `hidden ... sm:flex` so it renders `display:none` at <640px - verified on all 3 viewports.

Header.jsx: mobile icon buttons (`mobile-history-btn`, `mobile-favorites-btn`) are exactly 32x32px which meets the >=32px audit floor but is at the recommended minimum. Consider bumping padding from `p-2` to `p-2.5` for a comfortable 36-40px touch target if UX wants extra breathing room. Not blocking.
Home.jsx FeaturesStrip: `grid-cols-2 ... md:grid-cols-4` correctly renders 2x2 on mobile (verified `grid-template-columns` returns exactly 2 tracks on 360/375/390).
Home.jsx hero-title uses `text-3xl` (30px) on mobile which lies in the 28-40px range as required. sm: bumps to text-5xl.

HistoryDrawer.jsx: SheetContent is `w-full max-w-md` and slides in from right - at 375px width it fills the viewport (drawer.bbox.width=375, x=356 due to the transform's paint offset while animating in), does not overflow the document (body.scrollWidth stays 375), and is dismissible with Escape.
Theme toggle switching to Light removes `dark` class from <html> and no horizontal scroll appears. Verified programmatically.
index.css `body { overflow-x: hidden }` + `.tp-container` responsive padding (1rem base) is the right defense-in-depth against accidental overflow from marketing copy or extractor error messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsiveness pass complete. Key measured values for regression: iphone_se(375) hero fontSize=30px, hero bbox width=343, paste-input height=52, submit btn=40x40 with 1 svg and no 'Preview' text, paste-clipboard-btn display=none, features grid = '165.5px 165.5px'. iphone_12(390) hero width=358, submit at x=327. android(360) hero width=328 (wraps to 3 lines, height=108). All 5 header controls (brand-link, theme-toggle, mobile-history-btn, mobile-favorites-btn, mobile-login-btn) present & tappable on all 3 viewports. document.body.scrollWidth === window.innerWidth on all viewports including after error-panel appearance and after theme change. If the invisible-header logo bbox width (145px) is redesigned, keep total < 200px so it doesn't collide with the 3-icon cluster at 360px width.
